title: Customers who never ordered
prompt:
SQLite. Submit exactly one SELECT statement (a second, semicolon-separated statement is rejected).

Tables:
  customers(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL)
  orders(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, customer_id INTEGER NOT NULL)

Every orders.customer_id points at a customers.id and is never NULL. Return the name of
every customer who has no orders at all. One column, named exactly: name. Row order does
not matter, and any formulation that returns the right rows scores the same.
